warning: Market-depth tiers are not available yet. effective_buy_gold currently uses the BBB market-value snapshot as a proxy. Safe scenario applies +7.5% to input buy prices. Sale recovery is credited only with explicit demand probability.

economics_model.ranking_metric: (material cost - expected sale recovery) / skill-up probability
economics_model.sale_recovery_rule: No demand probability = zero credited recovery

recipes.name: Runed Fel Iron Rod
recipes.notes: Mandatory one-time rod. TBC database difficulty 300/300/310/325/340; user already has the Runed Arcanite Rod, so it is treated as an existing tool rather than a market purchase.

recipes.name: Enchant Cloak - Superior Defense
recipes.notes: Phase 1 vendor formula. TBC database difficulty 285/300/317/335. Current Wowhead leveling guide uses it for 301-317.

recipes.name: Enchant Cloak - Major Armor
recipes.notes: Wowhead difficulty 310/320/335/350. Current leveling guide uses it from 317 and may extend it when Arcane Dust is cheap.

recipes.name: Enchant Chest - Major Spirit
recipes.notes: Trainer recipe. Leveling guide uses it 320-340.

recipes.name: Superior Wizard Oil
recipes.notes: Wowhead difficulty 340/340/350/360. Also requires 1 Imbued Vial; vial cost is not yet included.

recipes.name: Enchant Gloves - Major Strength
recipes.notes: Wowhead difficulty 340/350/365/380; baseline guide uses it after the 350 rod craft.

recipes.name: Enchant Ring - Striking
recipes.notes: Wowhead difficulty 360/370/385/400. Available from Karazhan reputation vendor path; usable in current phase if reputation requirement is met.

recipes.name: Enchant Ring - Spellpower
recipes.notes: Phase 3 recipe. Blizzard has Phase 3 launching August 27, 2026, so it is excluded from current Phase 2 optimization.

recipes.name: Enchant Chest - Defense
recipes.notes: Phase 5 recipe. Excluded from current Phase 2 optimization.
